working_definition: Epithelial cluster of the anterior ejaculatory duct of the adult male reproductive tract; authors' term FBbt:00004967 is the duct structure, whose wall is a single layer of epithelial cells.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Cell of the epithelium of the ejaculatory duct. It secretes antimicrobial peptides such as Drosomycin and Andropin (Samakovlis et al., 1991; Ferrandon et al., 1998).

justification: The authors' term is a structure (duct), not a cell. The cell-level equivalent is the duct epithelial cell; FBbt has no anterior-specific epithelial cell term, and this term covers anterior and posterior ducts, so broad match. It is an adult epithelial cell.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Duct that connects the vasa deferentia and accessory glands to the ejaculatory bulb in the male adult genitalia.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Authors' structure term; not a cell type.

recommendation: Use ejaculatory duct epithelial cell as a broad match to the cell-level equivalent of the authors' structure term.
